rationale: PINS the #419 G8 gap: the imports relationship kind (isGroovyImport edges) — the edge exists but no fixture guarded it, so a regression deleting import edges would be silent. Groovy semantics: each import declaration produces a dependency on the imported module; single imports carry the full dotted target (java.util.List, never the truncated java.util), wildcard imports (java.util.Map.*) carry the parent module with isWildcard, static imports carry the full static member path. Evidence tier: import-derived edges are import_based.
